verdict.rationale: Vanta's developer hub has a per-endpoint API reference (list tests, upload contract, create custom control, list business units, and others). The list-controls page tells users to pick a server from a dropdown "to issue requests against" the Gov endpoint, which indicates a live try-it console. SDKs are generated from the same OpenAPI spec, but the interactivity rests on a single mention, so quality is capped. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the try-it console and runnable code samples, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec (standard paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
